name: Rahul Sharma
bio: Grew up in Agra's old city and has been guiding visitors through its history and food for eight years, with a focus on Mughal-era architecture and stories that don't make it into guidebooks.

reviews.text: Rahul explained the history in a very easy way and helped us understand the local culture, in French, which made a huge difference.
Knew details about Agra Fort I hadn't read anywhere. Well worth it if you want more than the standard tour.

name: Priya Verma
bio: A former architecture student who now leads heritage walking tours and photography-focused visits around Agra's lesser-known corners.

reviews.text: Great eye for photo spots away from the crowds, and patient with our Spanish.

name: Imran Sheikh
bio: Specialises in the Islamic and Sufi architectural heritage of Agra and nearby Fatehpur Sikri, guiding in Hindi, English and Arabic.

reviews.text: Deep knowledge of Islamic architecture, explained everything in Arabic without losing nuance.
